page.title: Inventory
page.permissionNote: Only administrators and managers can record entries or adjust stock. Inventory views remain available.
page.stockNote: The totals on this screen cover the whole business and stay synchronized with the sum of each site's balances. Adjustments, entries, and transfers update both views together.

balances.noSites: No active sites yet. Create one to start tracking per-site stock.
balances.projectionNote: site balances are authoritative. Transfers can remain in transit, and aggregate product stock stays synchronized with the sum of site balances.
balances.transferRequiresTwoSites: At least two active sites are required to transfer stock.

transferHistory.title: Transfer history
transferHistory.description: Recent stock transfers between sites. You can receive in-transit shipments or void movements to reverse balances.
transferHistory.confirmVoidMessage: This will move {{quantity}} available units back from {{to}} to {{from}}. Balances will update immediately.
transferHistory.confirmVoidDiscrepancyMessage: Only {{received}} of {{shipped}} shipped units will move back from {{to}} to {{from}}. The {{shortage}} missing units will remain recorded as inventory shrinkage.
transferHistory.confirmVoidGeneric: This will reverse only the transferred stock that is still available. Confirmed shortages are never recreated.

transferReceive.title: Receive transfer
transferReceive.description: Record the actual received quantities. Each line defaults to the shipped amount — lower any line if units are missing.
transferReceive.discrepancyHelp: Recorded alongside the receipt when any line has a variance.
transferReceive.discrepancyPlaceholder: Optional — explain the cause (e.g., box arrived damaged, 3 units missing).

summary.shortage: Shortage of {{amount}} units detected across {{count}} lines.
summary.match: Received quantities match what was shipped.

errors.exceedsShipped: Received quantity cannot be greater than the shipped quantity.

transferModal.title: Transfer stock between sites
transferModal.noStockAtSource: No products with on-hand stock at the selected origin site.
transferModal.deferHelp: Origin is debited immediately. Destination is credited when the shipment arrives and you click Receive.
transferModal.serialsHelp: Select the exact physical units that will move to the destination site.
transferModal.noSerials: No sellable serial units are available at this site.
transferModal.noLots: No lot stock is available at the source site.

errors.sitesRequired: Please select both origin and destination sites.
errors.sitesIdentical: Origin and destination sites must be different.
errors.productRequired: Please select a product to transfer.
errors.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be greater than zero.
errors.quantityExceedsOnHand: Quantity exceeds the on-hand stock at the origin ({{available}}).
errors.lotAllocationInvalid: Select valid quantities from the exact source lots.

adjustment.title: Adjust {{name}}
adjustment.noProduct: Select a product before adjusting stock.
adjustment.siteScope: This adjustment updates the active site balance: {{site}}.
adjustment.lotTrackedHelp: This product tracks lots. Receive a named lot instead of editing aggregate stock.
adjustment.serialTrackedHelp: This product tracks serial numbers. Receive or sell exact units instead of editing aggregate stock.
adjustment.stockMin: Stock must be zero or greater

entry.noSelection: Select a product before recording inventory.
entry.lotModeHelp: This product tracks lots. The receipt updates the named batch and the active site's stock atomically.
entry.serialModeHelp: Enter one serial number per physical unit. The receipt adds the exact units and active-site stock atomically.
entry.serialNumbersPlaceholder:
One serial per line
SN-0001
SN-0002
entry.serialNumbersRequired: Enter at least one serial number
entry.serialNumbersDuplicate: Remove duplicate serial numbers before saving
entry.serialSiteRequired: Select an active site before receiving serial units.
entry.lotSiteRequired: Select an active site before receiving this lot.
entry.siteScope: This entry updates the active site balance: {{site}}.
entry.quantityMin: Quantity must be greater than zero
entry.costMin: Cost must be zero or greater

serialLookup.title: Warranty lookup
serialLookup.description: Find the current unit, latest sale, customer, and warranty date by exact serial number.
serialLookup.notFound: No unit was found with serial {{serial}}.

purchases.hint: Return only the quantities that are physically leaving stock back to the provider.
purchases.returnQtyMax: Only {{count}} units remain available to return
purchases.minItems: Select at least one line quantity to return
purchases.returnSerialsHelp: Select the exact physical units leaving for the supplier.
purchases.noReturnableSerials: No serial units from this purchase are currently available at the receiving site.
purchases.invalidLotAllocation: Select valid quantities from the exact lots received in this purchase.

orders.hint: Receive only the quantities that physically entered stock in this delivery.
orders.receiptNotesPlaceholder: Optional note about this delivery batch
orders.minItems: Select at least one line quantity to receive
orders.serialNumbersDuplicate: Remove duplicate serial numbers before receiving

receipt.title: Received lots
receipt.help: Identify every physical lot in base units. The sum must reconcile with the line quantity.
receipt.duplicate: Use one row per lot number
receipt.totalMaximum: Assigned {{total}} of at most {{maximum}} base units
receipt.invalidExact: Identify every lot and make its base-unit total match the purchase line.
receipt.invalidPartial: Identify each received lot with a valid quantity that does not exceed the pending units.

allocation.title: Exact lot allocation
allocation.help: Enter the physical quantity for each lot. Zero leaves that lot unchanged.
allocation.empty: No lot inventory is available for this operation.
allocation.exceeds: Quantity exceeds the available lot stock

transformations.title: Recipes and transformations
transformations.description: Convert stock through auditable recipes for assemblies, cuts, disassembly, portions and production.
transformations.error: The transformation operation could not be completed
transformations.noSite: Select an active site before managing or executing transformations.

recipe.loadError: The saved transformation recipes could not be loaded.
recipe.searchTruncated: Only the first 50 matching recipes are shown. Refine the name search to find another recipe.
recipe.searchEmptyDescription: Try another recipe name or clear the search.
recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.allSites: Recipe is available at every site
recipe.productSearchHelp: Search by name, SKU or barcode. Eligible results are added to every product selector without limiting the recipe to the first catalog page.
recipe.productSearchError: The catalog search could not be completed.
recipe.productSearchResultCount_one: {{count}} eligible product added to the selectors.
recipe.productSearchResultCount_other: {{count}} eligible products added to the selectors.
recipe.productSearchNoEligible: No active, non-serialized stock products matched this search.
recipe.invalid: Complete every line with unique products and positive quantities and cost weights.
recipe.emptyDescription: Create the first recipe to trace inputs, outputs, waste and cost.

execute.title: Execute {{recipe}}
execute.wasteLotsHelp: Assign waste to every physical lot that produced it. Each value is capped by the quantity consumed from that lot.
execute.wasteLotsEmpty: Allocate the consumed lots before recording lot-specific waste.
execute.invalid: Every input must have a positive consumed quantity.
execute.invalidLots: Lot-tracked inputs require exact sellable-lot quantities matching the consumed total.
execute.lotsError: The available lots could not be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
execute.invalidWaste: Waste needs a reason and cannot exceed its exact consumed input or lot.
execute.invalidOutputs: Every output needs a positive quantity and cost weight; lot outputs also need a new lot number.

history.title: Execution history
history.lineSummary: {{inputs}} frozen input rows · {{outputs}} frozen output rows
history.empty: No transformations have been executed at this site.
history.error: The transformation history could not be loaded.

details.title: Transformation details
details.error: The frozen transformation details could not be loaded.
details.noWaste: No waste was recorded for this execution.

void.title: Void transformation
void.description: This exact reversal is allowed only while output stock and costs remain unchanged.
